Example: Pip calculation

Using these inputs:

  • Currency pair: EUR/USD
  • Account currency: USD
  • Current price: 1.085
  • Size in: Lots
  • Position size: 1 lots
  • Pips moved: 20

The calculator returns:

  • Pip value: $10.00 (per pip on 100,000 units)
  • Standard lot: $10.00
  • Mini lot (0.1): $1.00
  • Micro lot (0.01): $0.100
  • Pip size: 0.0001 (10 USD per pip)
  • 20 pip move: +$200.00
